notes.title: JETPACK VACATION - Developer Livestream and Live Sports Event!
notes.notes:
Play 'JETPACK VACATION' VR with the game designers.

Meet Tourism Infinity at the Steam Next Fest on October 6 at 6PM PDT = 9PM EDT

Take part in a live sports match!

A free playable demo of the Jetpack Stadium is included!
